No task needs AI.

*Moon Diver* is a mobile game: a small robot dives into a deep lake on the
Moon to find lost crystals.

## Task 1 · The tetrad of Moon Diver (2 marks)

Write the element of the tetrad (**mechanics**, **story**, **aesthetics** or
**technology**) for each sentence.

a) The player swipes down to dive and taps to grab a crystal.

{{< answer-space lines=1 >}}

b) The robot must bring back the crystals before the base loses power.

{{< answer-space lines=1 >}}

c) Blue light, slow bubbles and calm electronic music.

{{< answer-space lines=1 >}}

d) The game runs at 60 fps on phones with 3 GB of memory.

{{< answer-space lines=1 >}}

## Task 2 · The jobs of the media (2 marks)

Write the main job (**feedback**, **guidance**, **mood**, **story** or
**identity**) of each media element of *Moon Diver*, and the effect on the
player in a few words.

a) A crystal at the bottom of the lake glows softly.

{{< answer-space lines=1 >}}

b) A bright chime plays when the robot grabs a crystal.

{{< answer-space lines=1 >}}

c) Slow, calm electronic music plays during the dive.

{{< answer-space lines=1 >}}

d) A short tune with three notes plays on the title screen and in every
advert of the game.

{{< answer-space lines=1 >}}
